title: Disclosure Desk Guidance: The Application Fee Line of a Mortgage Loan File Revised Loan Estimate
content:
On a revised Loan Estimate for a Mortgage Loan File, the application fee in the program's fee sheet follows what the file's fee ledger shows about the application fee: the application fee collection, and any refund of it (a denial or improper-collection refund, or a withdrawal refund).

**Rule.** Where an application fee collection entry is on the file's fee ledger, whatever its amount (a 0.00 collection included), and none of it has been refunded, the program's application fee in the fee sheet is replaced by the amount actually collected; where the collection on the ledger has been refunded in full, the program's application fee is taken out of the fee sheet; where no application fee collection is on the ledger, as for a program that charges no application fee, the program's application fee stays in the fee sheet.

| Fee ledger shows | Application fee in the fee sheet |
|---|---|
| a collection entry of any amount, 0.00 included, nothing refunded | the amount actually collected, in place of the program's application fee |
| a collection, refunded in full | taken out — no application fee in the sheet |
| no collection | the program's application fee stays |

## Cases (hypothetical, program application fee of 450.00 USD)

- The ledger shows a collection of 225.00 USD and no refund: the sheet carries 225.00 USD instead of 450.00 USD, so the sheet is 225.00 USD lower than with the program's fee.
- The ledger shows a collection entry of 0.00 USD (a fee settled in full) and no refund: the sheet carries 0.00 USD instead of 450.00 USD.
- The ledger shows a collection of 450.00 USD refunded in full on denial: the sheet carries no application fee, 450.00 USD lower than with the program's fee.
- The ledger shows no collection: the sheet carries the program's 450.00 USD.
